newsitem.title: USA: Hardinge sees Q1 charge of $0.20 per share.
newsitem.headline: Hardinge sees Q1 charge of $0.20 per share.

text.p: Hardinge Inc said Monday that its net income for the first quarter of 1997 will be impacted by a non-recurring after-tax charge of approximately $1.2 million, or $0.20 per share.
This one-time charge is a result of costs incurred in connection with a major acquisition that the company decided not to pursue during its due diligence process.
But Hardinge said that both first quarter sales and earnings excluding the one-time charge, are expected to be higher than in last year's comparable period.
Net income, the company added, is expected to be consistent with analyst expectations, excluding the charge. First Call estimates for the first quarter are $0.75 a share.
Harding designs and manufactures computer- numerically controlled metal-cutting lathes, machining centers and grinding machines.
